newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's El Abra to hit full output in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Chile's El Abra to hit full output in Dec.

text.p: El Abra copper mine expects to bring its stricken conveyor belt back into operation early next month and reach full production by the end of December, site manager John Fenn said.

Despite delays caused by a serious accident at the conveyor belt on October 9, the mine, owned by Cyprus Amax, will still reach full production about six months earlier than originally planned, said Fenn.
"We should have it back into production by early November," Fenn told Reuters, referring to the 11-kilometer long belt which carries ore from a primary crusher to a second one.
